safe_test_strategy: Request only designated non-sensitive canary files with paired controls.
expected_behavior: File lookup must stay inside its configured root.

potential_false_positives.scenario: Public, cached, reflected or synthetic content resembles a protected result.
potential_false_positives.mitigation: Verify the resource policy, distinct identities, provenance and negative controls before confirming.

confirmation_criteria: Content of a designated canary outside the allowed logical root is retrieved.
